scoring.method: Each chosen option adds its weights to the running totals. Total points per dosha are summed across all questions.
scoring.primary: The dosha with the highest total.
scoring.blend: If the top two totals are within 15% of the combined total of all three doshas, the result is a blend (e.g. vata_pitta).
scoring.disclaimer: This is a self-reflection tool based on traditional Ayurvedic categories. It is not a medical test.
